title: Export/backup menu, printable report, notes collapsed by default, quieter help icons
changes: Excel export, backup and restore moved into one 'export and backup' menu; a new 'print / PDF' item prints the current tab (inputs, results and chart on one landscape A4 page). Original button ids are unchanged
The menu reminds that data is stored only in this browser
The notes panel starts collapsed for new users; a saved preference is still respected
The '?' help icons are dimmed until the field is hovered or focused
